rentShadingPct.note: Rental income shading is not published publicly.

maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: 'Owner occupiers can borrow up to 95% of the property's value with principal and interest repayments or 80% with interest only repayments.'

maxLvrInvestmentPct.sourceTitle: NAB Tailored Home Loan - variable rate with offset product sheet
maxLvrInvestmentPct.note: 'Investors can borrow up to 90% of the property's value with principal and interest repayments or interest only repayments.'

maxLvrNoLmiPct.sourceTitle: NAB Tailored Home Loan - variable rate with offset product sheet
maxLvrNoLmiPct.note: 'LMI is charged when your LVR is more than 80%.'

lmiCapitalisable.sourceTitle: NAB Tailored Home Loan - variable rate with offset product sheet
lmiCapitalisable.note: 'If LMI is required, we will inform you of the cost and give you the option to pay for it up front or to add it to your loan balance.'

minLoanAmount.sourceTitle: NAB Tailored Home Loan - variable rate with offset product sheet
minLoanAmount.note: 'Minimum $20,000 with no maximum (subject to standard assessment)'.

maxLoanAmount.sourceTitle: NAB Tailored Home Loan - variable rate with offset product sheet

offsetAvailable.sourceTitle: NAB Tailored Home Loan - variable rate with offset product sheet

redrawAvailable.sourceTitle: NAB Tailored Home Loan - variable rate with offset product sheet
redrawAvailable.note: Variable rate loans: minimum $500 per redraw transaction, if at least one full repayment ahead of schedule.

constructionAvailable.sourceTitle: NAB Tailored Home Loan - variable rate with offset product sheet
constructionAvailable.note: Loan purposes include 'building/construction loans (only available on interest only loans)'; construction includes an interest-only payment period of one or two years.

gaps: NAB's broker portal is login-gated, so no NAB-published assessment buffer, floor rate, DTI cap, rent shading, credit card assessment rate or HEM basis could be sourced.
No published income-type table, employment tenure minimums, credit knock-outs, security/postcode restrictions or residency/visa rules.
Maximum loan term and interest-only maximum terms are not stated on the public product sheet.
LMI waiver professions (NAB does operate a professional LMI waiver) are not published on a public NAB page.
Primary source is dated 10 February 2025 - re-check against a newer NAB product sheet.
